g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure Machine Learning MLOps with private workspace, CI runners and AKS inference

g.title: None.None.Node.24
g.text: Data scientists connect over point-to-site VPN
and explore data on their compute instances
A merge to main queues a workflow; the self-hosted runners pick it up from GitHub through the NAT gateway
The runners submit the training pipeline to the Azure ML workspace through its private endpoint
The workspace scales out the GPU compute cluster for the run
which reads the training data and writes the evaluated model to Blob Storage, then registers it
After approval the runners roll the new model out to the online endpoint on AKS
AKS loads the model files from Blob Storage and the image from Container Registry
Claims handlers open a claim in the claims app
which calls the endpoint over the virtual network for a fraud score
